boss.oldrepublic.collector.banner.title: Orren Vasch
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.give_bac: Orren Vasch: "Give them back? To whom?"
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.sing: Orren Vasch: "Listen to them sing. That is what the Treaty sold."
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.burns: Orren Vasch: "Every Order burns what it fears. I only kept what they would have burned."
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.offer: Orren Vasch: "You walked away from them too. Stay. Read with me."
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.yield: Orren Vasch: "Enough. They were never mine to keep, were they?"
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.peaceful: Orren Vasch: "No blades. Not in this place. Ask what you came to ask."
boss.oldrepublic.collector.line.kneeling: He kneels at the dais and does not look up.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.vault_sealed: The vault is sealed. Its keeper still kneels, or still stands.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.door_sealed: The doorway is sealed while the Collector fights.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.inert: The heart is cold. Nothing below is listening.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.not_owner: The heart answers only the one who opened this place.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.echo_running: The echo already stirs in the hall.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.yielded: The heart beats slowly. He waits at the dais for your word.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.fighting: The heart pounds. The fight is still going on.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.listening: The heart is warm. Something below is listening.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.no_echo: There is no echo to call here.
boss.oldrepublic.heart.peaceful: The echo will not form while the world is at peace (Peaceful difficulty).
boss.oldrepublic.heart.unchained_locked: Clear the echo once before you call it Unchained.
boss.oldrepublic.command.placed: Placed the Reliquary for %s; its heart is at %s %s %s. The hall finishes over the next ticks.
boss.oldrepublic.command.placed_forced: No site passed the checks; forced the Reliquary for %s 24 blocks ahead. Its heart is at %s %s %s.
boss.oldrepublic.command.already: The Collector of %s is already fighting or kneeling.
boss.oldrepublic.command.phase_refused: The Collector of %s cannot jump to phase %s now.
boss.oldrepublic.command.phase: The Collector of %s jumps to phase %s.
boss.oldrepublic.command.no_heart: %s has no loaded Reliquary heart in this dimension (or it is resolved).
dialogue.oldrepublic.reliquary_heart.lis: The heart is warm under your hand. Below, in the hall, something remembers his shape.
dialogue.oldrepublic.reliquary_heart.qui: The heart is quiet. Whatever it remembers is already awake.
dialogue.oldrepublic.reliquary_heart.unc: Call it without restraint? The echo will be stronger, and it will not hold back at the end.
dialogue.oldrepublic.reliquary_heart.fai: The echo cannot be called now.
boss.oldrepublic.sentinel.command.spawne: Spawned %s at %s, %s, %s (bound: always hostile, owned by you when a player runs the command)
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.name: Torvin Kaast, the hunter
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.gate_closed: The gate is shut while the hunt is on.
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.gate_not_yours: This camp is not waiting for you.
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.gate_quiet: The camp is quiet. Nothing answers.
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.echo_called: You strike the gate. Somewhere in the camp, a jet pack coughs into life.
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.echo_done_today: The camp has had its hunt today. Come back tomorrow.
boss.oldrepublic.kaast.command.camp_fail: Could not place a hunting camp for %s (they must stand on a planet, with its hub placed)
death.attack.oldrepublic.jet_slam: %1$s was crushed by a jet slam
